name: Rocket Warehouse & Ariana Showdown
summary: Infiltrate the sprawling Team Rocket Warehouse hidden within Chrono Meadow. Battle past security grunts and maneuver around heavy industrial machinery. In the rear generator room, confront and capture a Level 55 static Steel-type Klinklang. Eavesdrop on a heated summit between Rocket Executives and visiting Team Plasma operatives before breaching the command office. Defeat Executive Ariana in a 6 vs 6 syndicate raid, retrieve the stolen Sapphire from the office vault, and return to Knot Island to complete Celio's Network Machine.

items.name: Sapphire
items.method: Retrieved from the executive office vault after defeating Executive Ariana

Static.notes: Static encounter vibrating within the warehouse rear generator room. Plus ability.
